repository.name: @webex/plugin-webhooks
repository.purpose: Public plugin registered as webex.webhooks that manages Webex webhook registrations through the Webex REST API webhooks resource (catalog service hydra): create POSTs a webhook, get takes a webhook object or id and resolves one webhook, list resolves a webex-core Page, remove DELETEs a webhook and resolves undefined on a 204, and update PUTs the whole webhook object. Each call sends one request through webex.request and resolves what the service returns; the plugin checks no argument, does not receive or verify webhook deliveries, emits no SDK event, and caches or persists nothing.

commands.unit-test: [NEEDS HUMAN INPUT] -- package.json defines no test:unit script and the package has no test/unit directory; its only spec, test/integration/spec/webhooks.js, is wrapped in describe.skip and runs only under test:browser, which currently bundles nothing. Add a unit suite and script before recording a command here.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/plugin-webhooks package entry
public_interfaces.audience: SDK bundles (webex, webex-node) and applications that build their own webex instance
public_interfaces.notes: Importing the package registers Webhooks as public plugin 'webhooks' with no config; the first registration of the name wins. The default export Webhooks is the only export.

public_interfaces.name: webex.webhooks methods
public_interfaces.notes: Each method sends one hydra webhooks request. get and remove take a webhook object or an id; get resolves body.items when present, else the body; list resolves a webex-core Page; remove resolves undefined on a 204, else the body; update sends the whole object as the body. get, remove, and update read webhook.id synchronously, so a missing argument throws a TypeError instead of rejecting. The plugin registers webhooks only: the service delivers events to targetUrl directly, and nothing in the package receives, verifies, or emits them.

public_interfaces.name: package scripts
public_interfaces.notes: build runs build:src, which writes dist. There is no test:unit script and no unit test. test:browser (commands.browser-test) runs karma over test/integration/spec but bundles nothing today (0 tests, exit 0), and the spec it would load is wrapped in describe.skip. The aggregate test script runs test:style, then exits 1 because test:unit is not defined (it also names test:integration, which is not defined either); it is deliberately not a manifest command.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not send webhook requests outside this.request with service hydra.
negative_guidance.why: webex-core resolves the catalog URL and adds authorization and tracking only on that path.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not add argument checks, caching, or reshaping of the response without a unit case and a spec update.
negative_guidance.why: Callers receive the service response as it is today (MOD-002 to MOD-006).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not log webhook bodies, target URLs, filters, or ids through webex.logger.
negative_guidance.why: A target URL and its filter name where Webex event data is sent; the plugin logs nothing today.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not add a webhook delivery receiver or signature check to this package without an ADR.
negative_guidance.why: The package only registers webhooks; receiving deliveries happens at the caller's targetUrl, outside the SDK.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat README.md as the behavior reference.
negative_guidance.why: It shows only get(id); see docs/adr/0001-retain-product-readme.md.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not infer a coverage threshold or a unit-test command for this package.
negative_guidance.why: No unit test, test:unit script, coverage script, or threshold exists.
